title: EnrollPayload
description: Face roster traffic in both directions. Server to kiosk pushes templates and assignments; kiosk to server reports what an operator did at the machine. Carries the int8 embedding and its dequant scale exactly as they land in the 552-byte record of KEHOACH 6.2.4.

op.description: DELETE removes one template, DELETE_EMPLOYEE removes every template of the employee, REPLACE_ALL is the full-resync path. ASSIGN names an employee the kiosk should expect to enroll and carries no embedding, REVOKE withdraws that expectation.

templateIdx.description: One employee holds several templates: frontal, glasses, low light.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds UTC. The kiosk keeps the newer of two conflicting pushes.

embedding.description: 512 int8 values, base64 of the raw bytes. Required for UPSERT.

scale.description: Dequant factor for embedding. Required for UPSERT.

quality.description: Enrollment image quality; breaks ties when two templates collide.

embeddingVersion.description: Recognition model that produced the embedding. A kiosk running a different model must refuse the template rather than compare across models.

fullName.description: Shown on the kiosk screen after a match. Display only.

rosterVersion.description: Server to kiosk: the roster generation this device stands at once it has applied this op. The kiosk reports it back in every heartbeat, which is what lets the server push exactly what a machine missed while it was offline.

deviceId.description: Kiosk to server only: which machine is reporting.
